events.note: Horizons APmag reaches its least value, -4.804, on a plateau from 23 to 25 September, because the reference gives magnitudes to only three decimals. A parabolic fit to the ten-minute samples puts the minimum at 24 September 06:24 UT, and the fitted vertex ranges from 05:56 to 07:57 UT depending on the fit window (±24 h to ±48 h); the ±60-minute tolerance reflects that plateau, not slack in caelundas. Swiss Ephemeris pheno_ut has its least magnitude at 06:42 UT. Almanacs listing 18 September 23 UT (EarthSky, Sea and Sky) give greatest illuminated extent, the maximum of illuminated fraction over distance squared, not the least magnitude
